extracted.name: Microwave brownie 😋
extracted.description: Easy mug microwave brownie done in less than 2 minutes! You can top it off with your favorite ice cream or fruit. Yum! 😋🍓
instruction_lines: Start by assembling all dry ingredients in a microwave safe mug. Mix well
Then add all the wet ingredients and mix well.
Top it off with strawberries and ice cream and enjoy!
